title: Spicy Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish originating from North Africa, made with tender chicken, rich spices, and sweet vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in the bottom of the tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tagine spice blend, carrots, potatoes, chicken broth, and honey.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving.
